Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
From the rule book:

"The regent counts as cardinal by cards and other effects, but has an additional vote as well."

If I control a ready Regent but no other titled vampires, can I play Gurchon Hall which requires a Cardinal, but has no "reminder text" about Regents? (Would/could a methuselah's ability to play such cards be considered an "other effect"?)

If not, does it make sense to alter that rule book sentence so the card can be played??

Thanks.

When you are anvil, be patient; when a hammer, strike.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
When asking a question about a card, I recommend quoting cardtext.
When quoting cardtext, I recommend taking it from the one source: the  Cardlist on vekn.net.

So, let's have a look at Gurchon Hall's cardtext:
>
> Name: Gurchon Hall
> [Third:R2]
> Cardtype: Master
> Cost: 3 pool
> Master: unique location. Requires a ready cardinal {or regent}. Hunting ground.
> During your untap phase, you may move 1 blood from the blood bank to each of the two oldest ready vampires you control. A vampire can gain blood from only one hunting ground card each turn.
> Artist: Heather Kreiter
>
There, problem solved

(for those who wonder: the question has been asked here:  [LSJ 20061002] , where LSJ states the csv has been updated)
